name: Mercure Hanoi la Gare
short_description: A 4-star Mercure on Ly Thuong Kiet Street in Hanoi's French Quarter, opposite Hanoi Railway Station and near the Old Quarter, holding a 4.6/5 ALL Rating (1,014 reviews).
ai_summary: Mercure Hanoi la Gare is a 4-star hotel on Ly Thuong Kiet Street in Hanoi's French Quarter, directly in front of Hanoi Railway Station for easy train journeys to Sapa and Ninh Binh. It is a 5-minute walk from the ICE Exhibition Centre and within walking distance of the French Quarter, Old Quarter, Hoan Kiem Lake, and Train Street. Facilities include a meeting room, 24/7 gym, and the Brasserie Le Pavillon restaurant. The hotel holds a 4.6/5 ALL Rating from 1,014 reviews on its own Accor page. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.
